name: assets_kind_change_line
description: GH #3902 / REQ-759 (assets C15 part 2), docs/assets/change-of-kind.md section 2. One line of a change of kind: a stock SKU (item, unit, optional lot, quantity, stock location and stock responsible) that becomes an asset (target kind, asset org unit, asset location, material responsible, optional actual user, inventory number, name). header_id is the record_id of the assets_kind_change header (not the document id); the foreign_keys entry promotes it to a uuid column with ON DELETE RESTRICT (inert on the soft-delete path). org_unit_id is the header's value copied by the module (queried; the scope column). line_no is the position 1..n. asset_card_id stays empty here: the card is created by the posting of REQ-760. The ids point to records of other packs (no foreign key); the module checks them at issue. quantity is an exact decimal (precision 24, scale 9, decimal_strict); the value rule is checked at issue. There is no price or value field. Written only by module assets.
